scope: 40 product families across private chats, groups, channels, inline, Business and Mini Apps.

intro.title: Telegram: introduction to bots
intro.supports: Official examples of commerce, AI, tools, games and service integrations; not a ranking.

features.title: Telegram Bot Features
features.supports: Interaction surfaces: commands, keyboards, deep links, inline queries and bot setup.

api.title: Telegram Bot API
api.supports: Method, update and context contracts. Checked 2026-11-15: Bot API 10.4.

stars.title: Payments for digital goods and services
stars.supports: Stars flow, payment confirmation and digital-goods constraints.

miniapps.title: Telegram Mini Apps
miniapps.supports: Launch modes, validation of initData, richer web interfaces and device features.

business.title: Introducing Telegram Business
business.supports: Connected bots answering customers; business hours, quick replies and human workflows.

affiliate.title: Affiliate Programs
affiliate.supports: Native referral commissions for Stars purchases; distinct from a custom loyalty ledger.

webapps.title: Telegram Mini Apps
webapps.supports: Launch points, the Telegram.WebApp API, initData validation and the Mini App design guidelines.

use_cases.title: Physical-goods shop and restaurant orders
intent: catalog cart checkout магазин корзина заказ кафе
use_cases.priority_reason: Commerce combines reusable forms, payments and tracking.
use_cases.gap: Real inventory, fulfillment and provider integration.

use_cases.title: Digital goods and paid content
intent: digital course download цифровой товар платный контент
use_cases.priority_reason: Correct entitlement handling is reusable across paid bots.
use_cases.gap: Persistent paid entitlement and refund reconciliation.

use_cases.title: Membership and recurring subscription
intent: membership subscription paywall подписка доступ клуб
use_cases.priority_reason: Payment and access must have separate lifecycles.
use_cases.gap: Join/leave entitlement synchronization and reconciliation.

use_cases.title: Customer support and human handoff
intent: helpdesk ticket support поддержка оператор тикеты
use_cases.priority_reason: Human handoff recurs in nearly every service bot.
use_cases.gap: CRM integration, operator assignment and service hours.

use_cases.title: Appointments and reservations
intent: appointment booking salon запись бронирование салон
use_cases.priority_reason: Slots, holds and confirmation are reusable building blocks.
use_cases.gap: Transactional slot allocation and external calendar sync.

use_cases.title: Onboarding, referrals and settings
intent: onboarding start language settings старт настройки язык
use_cases.priority_reason: Every product needs entry, recovery and preferences.
use_cases.gap: Project-specific consent and account linking.

use_cases.title: Courses, quizzes and language practice
intent: course lesson quiz study обучение курс урок язык
use_cases.priority_reason: Progress and feedback support repeated use.
use_cases.gap: Curriculum storage, accessible content and reminder rules.

use_cases.title: AI chat, research and generation
intent: ai assistant research generation нейросеть ассистент генерация
use_cases.priority_reason: Cancellation and single finalization recur across AI tools.
use_cases.gap: Model provider, quotas, retention and factual evaluation.

use_cases.title: Search, directories and knowledge retrieval
intent: search directory catalog knowledge поиск каталог база знаний
use_cases.priority_reason: Many verticals are search with permissions.
use_cases.gap: Search backend and per-result authorization.

use_cases.title: Monitoring, prices and stock availability
intent: monitoring alert price stock мониторинг уведомления цена наличие
use_cases.priority_reason: Thresholds and notification fatigue need explicit controls.
use_cases.gap: Trusted data source, staleness rules and durable scheduler.

use_cases.title: Order, delivery and application tracking
intent: delivery parcel status трекинг доставка статус посылка
use_cases.priority_reason: One object with changing status is widely reusable.
use_cases.gap: Webhook reconciliation and authenticated tracking IDs.

use_cases.title: Shared expenses and personal balances
intent: split expenses group balance расходы разделить счёт баланс
use_cases.priority_reason: Shared and personal audiences must remain distinct.
use_cases.gap: Durable ledger and reconciliation; no real money moves.

use_cases.title: Communities, rules and join requests
intent: community welcome rules join группа правила вступление
use_cases.priority_reason: Member lifecycle is a foundation for group products.
use_cases.gap: Current admin rights and membership event reconciliation.

use_cases.title: Inline sharing and collaborative cards
intent: inline share card инлайн поделиться карточкой
use_cases.priority_reason: Sharing is a different audience and callback model.
use_cases.gap: Discovery setup and per-query cache policy.

use_cases.title: Business inbox assistant
intent: business customer auto reply бизнес клиент автоответ
use_cases.priority_reason: Business account permissions differ from normal bot chats.
use_cases.gap: Connection revocation and operator ownership policy.

use_cases.title: Channel publishing and editorial workflows
intent: channel content publish канал публикация редакция
use_cases.priority_reason: Unknown send outcomes must not create duplicate posts.
use_cases.gap: Production scheduling and editorial permission store.

use_cases.title: News, RSS and subscription digests
intent: rss digest news дайджест новости подписки
use_cases.priority_reason: Merge, dedupe and quiet delivery compose existing flows.
use_cases.gap: Feed connectors, attribution and user topic preferences.

use_cases.title: Polls, feedback and group decisions
intent: poll vote decision голосование опрос решение
use_cases.priority_reason: Native polls and identified forms have different privacy.
use_cases.gap: Anonymous aggregate reporting vs identified response storage.

use_cases.title: Agent control and developer operations
intent: agent deploy build approve агент деплой сборка согласование
use_cases.priority_reason: Operator isolation and approval bind consequential actions.
use_cases.gap: Real runner isolation, durable approvals and audit.

use_cases.title: Incident response and on-call
intent: incident oncall alert инцидент дежурный авария
use_cases.priority_reason: Escalation should preserve one incident identity.
use_cases.gap: On-call provider, escalation and resolution sync.

use_cases.title: Lead qualification and quote requests
intent: lead crm quote заявки лиды расчёт консультация
use_cases.priority_reason: Intake is distinct from a purchase or support ticket.
use_cases.gap: CRM outbox, editable multi-step intake and contact validation.

use_cases.title: Event registration and waitlist
intent: event registration waitlist мероприятие регистрация лист ожидания
use_cases.priority_reason: Capacity, cancellation and FIFO promotion differ from slot booking.
use_cases.gap: Database capacity lock, ticket tokens and staff check-in UI.

use_cases.title: Personal reminders and recurring habits
intent: reminder snooze habit todo напоминание отложить привычки задачи
use_cases.priority_reason: Time zones and leased jobs are failure-prone.
use_cases.gap: Timezone picker, DST resolution, recurrence and durable outbox.

use_cases.title: PDF tools, transcription and media jobs
intent: pdf file convert transcription ocr файл конвертация расшифровка
use_cases.priority_reason: Late worker completion after cancel needs a firm boundary.
use_cases.gap: File retrieval, sandboxed processing, retention and result delivery.

use_cases.title: Moderation reports and review queue
intent: moderation spam report модерация спам жалоба
use_cases.priority_reason: A report is a request for review, not authority to punish.
use_cases.gap: Live rights checks, evidence retention, appeal and safe execution.

use_cases.title: Feedback, NPS and intake surveys
intent: survey feedback nps анкета отзыв оценка
use_cases.priority_reason: Incomplete answers and withdrawal need real state.
use_cases.gap: Question navigation, retention and aggregate reporting.

use_cases.title: Custom loyalty and reward points
intent: loyalty points rewards бонусы лояльность баллы
use_cases.priority_reason: Repeated settled-order events must not credit twice.
use_cases.gap: Trusted order events, refunds, reward fulfillment and transactional ledger.

use_cases.title: Electronic queue and service desk
intent: queue ticket waiting очередь талон ожидание
use_cases.priority_reason: Queue position differs from an appointment and ETA.
use_cases.gap: Shared persistence, staff UI, no-show policy and notifications.

use_cases.title: Recruiting and applicant tracking
intent: hiring job resume recruiting вакансии резюме подбор
use_cases.priority_reason: Reuses intake, file processing and private status.
use_cases.gap: ATS integration, resume retention and reviewer permissions.

use_cases.title: Classifieds, rental and service marketplace
intent: marketplace rental classifieds объявления аренда маркетплейс
use_cases.priority_reason: Search and seller inquiry exist; marketplace trust does not.
use_cases.gap: Seller identity, disputes, listing moderation and inventory.

use_cases.title: Travel, weather and nearby services
intent: weather transport nearby travel погода транспорт рядом путешествия
use_cases.priority_reason: Combines search and subscriptions with external data.
use_cases.gap: Location consent, live feed licensing and stale-data display.

use_cases.title: Games, challenges and leaderboards
intent: game challenge leaderboard игра челлендж рейтинг
use_cases.priority_reason: Quiz primitives do not implement a game economy.
use_cases.gap: Authoritative scoring, anti-cheat, game loop and accessibility.

use_cases.title: Wallet and transaction status
intent: wallet ton crypto transaction кошелёк перевод транзакция
use_cases.priority_reason: Sent notifications do not prove settlement.
use_cases.gap: Chain verification, reconciliation and audited custody boundaries.

use_cases.title: Mini App companion and account surface
intent: mini app dashboard portal мини приложение кабинет портал
use_cases.priority_reason: Chat and web surfaces should share one account state.
use_cases.gap: Validated initData, web UI and backend authorization.

use_cases.title: Referral and native affiliate programs
intent: affiliate referral partner партнёрка реферал рекомендации
use_cases.priority_reason: Native commissions differ from a custom bonus ledger.
use_cases.gap: Native affiliate setup and refund-aware attribution; R86 is not that integration.

use_cases.title: Internal employee requests and approvals
intent: employee hr leave expense сотрудник отпуск согласование
use_cases.priority_reason: Combines intake and role-bound approval.
use_cases.gap: Employee identity, approver hierarchy and HR integration.

use_cases.title: Device and home automation controls
intent: iot device home automation умный дом устройство управление
use_cases.priority_reason: A successful command does not prove device state.
use_cases.gap: Device identity, acknowledgments, stale state and scoped controls.

use_cases.title: Matching, clubs and social discovery
intent: matching social dating club знакомства клуб сообщества
use_cases.priority_reason: Profiles and safety require more than shared cards.
use_cases.gap: Mutual consent, blocking, moderation and deletion flows.

use_cases.title: Sticker, emoji and media creation tools
intent: sticker emoji media creation стикер эмодзи пак медиа
use_cases.priority_reason: Pack styling differs from creating user media.
use_cases.gap: Media pipeline, ownership, pack management and moderation.

use_cases.title: Returns, refunds and after-sales support
intent: refund return warranty возврат гарантия поддержка
use_cases.priority_reason: Post-purchase state must remain linked to the original order.
use_cases.gap: Refund reconciliation and provider-specific return workflow.

use_cases.title: Mini App storefront: catalogue, product cards, cart and checkout (books, goods, food)
intent: mini app shop catalog cart bookstore магазин книг каталог корзина мини-апп
use_cases.priority_reason: Catalogues with photos and filters are the most common reason to build a Mini App.
use_cases.gap: Real catalogue API, stock reservation and provider payments.

use_cases.title: Mini App booking: trainers, classes, appointments, tables
intent: book trainer gym class appointment slot запись к тренеру спортзал расписание слот мини-апп
use_cases.surface: Mini App + bot confirmations and reminders
use_cases.priority_reason: Slot grids and specialist choice do not fit buttons; reminders stay in the bot.
use_cases.gap: Availability API, holds and calendar sync.

use_cases.title: SaaS in a Mini App: dashboard, portfolio, loyalty, settings and plans
intent: saas dashboard metrics portfolio loyalty settings subscription plans дашборд личный кабинет тарифы мини-апп
use_cases.surface: Mini App + bot alerts with startapp links
use_cases.priority_reason: Dense data and settings belong in an app; alerts open the exact screen.
use_cases.gap: Your data API and billing provider.

use_cases.title: Mini App games and leaderboards shared to chats
intent: game leaderboard fullscreen share score игра лидерборд поделиться результатом
use_cases.surface: fullscreen Mini App + prepared inline messages
use_cases.priority_reason: Fullscreen, gestures and sharing are Mini App-only capabilities.
use_cases.gap: The game itself and anti-cheat on the server.

use_cases.title: Mini App editor and admin tools with publish confirmation
intent: editor admin moderation drafts publish редактор модерация черновик публикация
use_cases.priority_reason: Long text with autosave and conflicts needs an app; publishing needs a bound approval.
use_cases.gap: Rich text editing and media upload.
